customer_name: State Grid Hunan Electric Power Company
business_problem: Hunan Electric Power needed a faster way to locate outages, plan repairs, and respond under severe weather because manual fault investigation across transmission lines was slow and made emergency power-restoration work harder during storms.
solution_summary: State Grid Hunan and Baidu AI Cloud built a map-based external service around Baidu Maps to support outage analysis, repair routing, and infrastructure visualization. The service links real-time traffic information with electric-grid system data so outage devices and affected areas can be located precisely on the map instead of traced manually along feeder lines. The same map layer combines user information, line information, and device information into a single 'power-grid map' that supports repair planning and dispatch. Because Baidu Maps can incorporate congestion data, route selection, time prediction, satellite imagery, terrain, 3D data, and GPS track playback, the service also improves field repair coordination and helps ensure app, WeChat, and customer-service data remain consistent.

solution_components.name: Baidu Maps Intelligent Logistics Solution
solution_components.role: Provides the map-based service layer used for outage localization, routing, and repair dispatch.

solution_components.name: Logistics Map
solution_components.role: Acts as the spatial operating surface that merges grid devices, route information, and external context.

data_flow: Outage-device information and grid-system data are mapped onto Baidu's road and traffic layers, where the service locates affected areas, predicts routes and travel times, and feeds repair crews and service systems with updated outage and dispatch context. Weather and remote-sensing overlays add broader planning signals for emergency response.
business_outcome: Hunan Electric Power improved outage localization, dispatch efficiency, and field-repair planning while extending maps into a reusable digital-infrastructure layer for warnings, emergency response, and service coordination.
architecture_clues: The deployment creates a single 'power-grid map' by combining user, line, and device information
Real-time traffic data, weather, remote sensing, and repair-track playback are part of the operating surface
The service supports outage-area impact analysis and available distribution-transformer capacity display as expansion scenarios
evidence_quotes: Baidu AI Cloud and Hunan Electric Power completed a map external-network service based on real-time traffic information to achieve highly precise outage-range positioning (original: 完成基于实时路况信息的地图外网服务部署，实现了停电范围高精准定位).

Before the project, repair teams often had to inspect one or more power lines manually to determine the faulty equipment and restoration plan (original: 以往，抢修人员需要对一条或多条供电线进行排查，才能确定故障设备，然后紧急制定出电力修复方案).

The map service now links outage-device information to grid-system data, merges user, line, and equipment information into one map, and improves route planning and response efficiency (original: 实现了停电范围高精准定位，并由停电设备信息关联电网系统数据展示停电设备信息…通过百度地图，用户信息、线路信息和设备信息三流合一呈现在地图上).

The platform also supports route choice from congestion, customer-system consistency, equipment warning, weather display, remote-sensing analysis, and outage-impact analysis (original: 百度地图还可基于拥堵情况进行路线选择与时间预测…设备信息、状态、重载率等数据都可以通过地图查看…实现停电区域影响分析).
